contract.reference: TOR EC (IMPROVE_A protocol, ECTR) on collocated quartz filters, same sampling interval; concentration in µg/m³ with each filter's own volume
frozen models: SPARTAN published EC (deployed model, comparison only)

pass rules.note: reported only with ≥ 8 pairs spanning a factor of 3 in TOR EC

contract.low-signal handling: pairs with TOR EC below 3× the field-blank MDL are reported but excluded from the pass rules; negative FTIR predictions are kept as negative
contract.eligibility: identity-confirmed quartz/PTFE pairs, start times within 1 h, volume ratio 0.8–1.25; decided from metadata before TOR is opened
contract.representativeness check: before scoring: EC and PM per filter, and spectral distance, against SPARTAN Addis (Section 8 plots)
contract.precision: with 10 pairs the 95 % interval on mean bias is about ± the 'Addis-like' half width at n = 10 (table PRECISION)
contract.caveat: about 10 filters from a different site, sampler and flow: a check of the calibration, not a recalibration; they test the Addis problem only where they overlap SPARTAN Addis (season, loading per filter, OC/EC)
